displayName: Village of the Golden Fox People

parameters: "Well, this village looks friendly enough.  No one's shooting at us."
"Maybe they 'aren't programmed for that' because they have an 'error' and have to re-engage some magical intelligence personality here
in the Village of the Golden Fox People."
"Hey how did you know what the name of this place is?"
"Didn't you see the sign we passed as we walked into this Asian town?"
"\P[2]!  I didn't know you could read anything Asian!  When did this happen?"
"*Imitation* Asian, like how the sign was in English.  'Imitation' because this is Benny Zinkland's best guess as to what an Asian village
would be like.  Notice all the signs on all the shops?  How nothing here is in Asian, and everything is in English?  Just like how we would
sometimes play RPGs with Benny and when he was the Game Master, and loved to make an adventure in ancient Japan, but didn't know jack about
"Oh.  Yeah, I get it.  This place looks a lot more completed than the last prank, though.  I think he put a lot more work into this one.
You know, if he'd ask us first before pulling us into his worlds he creates, he'd be a lot better friend, and maybe he could make a career
out of his creativity.  He's getting better at making stuff like this, but geez, he should ask us first before teleporting us..."
"Yeah, if he'd ask us first, and when we were up to it to try one of his creations, that would be nice.  Its actually pretty neat that he can make
stuff like this, and he really does have a good side worth having as a friend, but you're right, these surprise pranks are a bit much.  I just
"If he would stop sharing his creations as surprise pranks, I wouldn't mind having and keeping him as a friend."
"Ready to go into the sewers and find Kaito?  Let's go!"
"Ready to talk to city maintainence for a key to the sewers?  Their office is at the elder's house, in the northern area of
"Ready to talk to Kaito's mother?  Let's go!"
You see a masked man wearing some kind of formal business suit.  His mask and his clothes have a golden color to them.
"Greetings young ones.  Welcome to our town.  We are the Golden Fox people.  I can tell that you are visitors from elsewhere."
"My name is Kenji.  I am one of the town's ninjas.  I serve the town elder."
"'Sup?  My name's \P[1].  I'm a half dragon, and most of my friends here are pure human.  Yeah, we're not from around here, all right."
"Look, I hate to cut introductions short, but there's a lady who lost her ten-year-old son named Kaito, who went into a sewer to play, and Kaito's
mother is freakin' out over it, and wanted us to get your help.  So can you help us?"
"Kaito!  I know this child!  He's been in trouble like this before, and yes, you did the right thing coming to me!"
"Let me join you, and we'll go talk to Kaito's mother!"
"Kenji, there's a lady who lost her ten-year-old son named Kaito, who went into a sewer to play, and Kaito's

"Let me join you, and we'll go talk to Kaito's mother!"

"My name is Kenji.  I am one of the town's ninjas.  I serve the town elder."
"'Sup?  My name's \P[1].  I'm a half dragon, and most of my friends here are pure human.  Yeah, we're not from around here, all right."
"Do you want me to go with you, around town?  I can answer questions, and fight alongside you if anything attacks you."
"I will stay with you in town and to the edges of this island, but not across any bridge to any other island."
"We'll look for Kaito in the sewer.  Sit tight."
"We will get one of the city workers to unlock a manhole, and go down into the sewer to look for your son."
"We'll get with Kenji and get into the sewer to find your kid, ma'am.  Don't worry."
You see a worried, somewhat frantic woman, who appears to be worried sick about something.  As you approach, she turns to
you, with desperate hope in her eyes.
"You there!  Can you people please help me?  I really need help from someone, and I promise I'll give what I can for your trouble!
Anything!  My son is in danger!  He's just a boy!"
1:  "What seems to be the problem ma'am?  Maybe we can help."
2:  "Sorry ma'am, we can't right now, maybe later."
"What seems to be the problem ma'am?  Maybe we can help.  We're just visitors to this town, but maybe we can do something."
"My ten-year-old son went outside to play, and didn't come back, and then I found out someone saw him climb down an open manhole
and go into the sewer!  I called his name, and heard him screaming for help the first time, and now nothing!"
"We will help.  What is your son's name?"
"Kaito.  Its been several hours now and I'm worried sick!"
"Please find Kenji, one of the town ninjas!  He would know what to do.  I would go in myself, but the manhole cover is shut tight and locked!
Kenji might know who has a key.  Please tell Kenji - my son's name is Kaito, and he's a student swordfighter but he's only ten!"
"Okay, we'll look for Kenji.  Sit tight."
"Sorry ma'am, we can't right now, maybe later.  I hope you find someone to help you with your problem, whatever it is."
"\P[1], I'm about to smack you!  This person has a child who's just a little boy, who's in danger, and you won't even listen to her tell you
what's going on, or try to find help for her?  Or her kid?  Shit \P[1]!  You...  Oh, never mind..."
Kenji whirls to face you, angry.
"\P[1]!  What kind of spoiled brat of a bad child are you!?  Have some decency and talk to that poor woman again, NOW!"
"The elder of the town lives beyond here.  Sorry kids, but I can't let just anyone pass through here."
"A young boy of the village has gotten into the sewers.  We need to go in after him and get him out."
"One of the city maintainence workers is right here!  Niko!"
A man hurries around the corner from inside the gate.  He has tech goggles and a utility belt with tools and equipment, as well as
"I overheard!  Here, take this key to the sewers!  With it you can walk up to any manhole and press the A Button, if you're using a controller, to enter the
sewers!  Go prepare with any gear you need from the shops first, and then I'll meet all of you down inside the sewer enterance.
We need to rescue that boy."
"The Golden Fox people and the Red Hawk folk have been at war for a long time.  We are bitter enemies."
"We've never gotten along with the Red Hawk folk.  Not as long as I've been alive, at least."
"Wow you guys must not be from around here.  Watch out for the Red Hawks, from another island.  They're really bad!"
"Thanks big guy, I'll keep that in mind."
"Try not to lose your head over it!"
"Oh so you're one of those super-smart kids!  Wow kid, where'd you learn to make a joke like that?"
The child doesn't answer, but just grins at you.
"Um, hi.  If you're new to town, there's an Inn over there."
The child points to the southeastern area of town.
"Hey why are you carrying your head like that?  It looks like it got cut off or something."
"Well it's 'cuz that's pretty much what happened to it."
"Are you one of those zarakites that doesn't die when their head gets cut off?"
"Nah, just half-zarakite.  But yeah, when my head is cut off I don't die or anything."
"I can see blood and guts in the top of your neck.  Does that hurt?"
"Nah, it doesn't hurt.  Yeah, I've got blood and guts that show on the bottom of my head too.  It happens when my head gets chopped off."
"The castle of The Dark is on another island south of this land.  That place is evil.  We don't mess with it and neither do
the Red Hawk folk.  Legend has it that there is other-worldly super-magic stuff there that no one should mess with."
"By any chance, have you ever seen or heard of a guy named Zinkland?  Benny Zinkland?"
The man frowns and shakes his head side-to-side.
